import os
from pathlib import Path
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Reflect the input across its outer edges to make a 3-by-2 array of copies.
    # Vertical copy order is flipped, normal, flipped; horizontal is flipped, normal.
    rows = [list(row) for row in grid]
    vertical = list(reversed(rows)) + rows + list(reversed(rows))
    return [list(reversed(row)) + row for row in vertical]
'''
